answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming. Each epoch the network sells 200 identity slots to top bidders, so hollow promises of cheap entry collapse under real bidding. Like yarrow, each deposit locks for 20 epochs: an attacker buying 1,000 identities at 50 POA each pays 50,000 POA and cannot recycle it. Precious like saffron because supply is fixed, slots work the same way: an honest agent pays once, earns it back, while the attacker bleeds.
